brief: On-device video tools that make space without making life complicated. Approved B identity: one open pocket, one folded tile.
criteria: One-color recognition, readable small sizes, Arabic and English use, room for future video tools.

concepts.name: A little room
concepts.idea: An open pocket makes room for one more possibility.
rationale: A warm abstract identifier beyond video compression.
A separate folded tile adds a memorable detail.
A custom K echoes the tile fold in the wordmark.

recommendation: Approved direction B. Kuymo is the product; Kuymo AI is the assistant descriptor.
